problem_keywords: Air leaks and thermal bypass at insulation foil seams
unsealed joins in building sarking and flexible ducting
use_cases: Repairing tears and punctures in aluminium foil building membranes
Sealing overlapping laps of reflective foil building wraps and roof sarking
Taping seams and joints on foil-faced glasswool blankets and HVAC duct wraps
retrieval.rag_summary:
Misc Tape Metalised represents metalised
polypropylene or aluminium foil pressure-sensitive tapes widely used in
Australian construction for joining and sealing reflective insulation, roof
sarking, and ductwork. Coated with aggressive acrylic or synthetic rubber
adhesives, these tapes create continuous moisture-tight and airtight seals
across membrane laps and penetrations. By preventing convective thermal bypass
and moisture ingress, they maintain system R-values and vapour barrier integrity
across roofs, walls, and HVAC systems.
